texts.label: תרגום לאנגלית
texts.citation: Motzkin, "The Arabic Correspondence of Judge Elijah and his Family" (PhD diss., n.p., 1965), 2.
texts.html:
Verso

  1. Your servant Solomon son of R. Elijah, (may he come to a) g(ood) e(nd),

  2. swears in this presence: I have not been reading (teaching from)

  3. this codex for (the last) six months and

  4. I did not have it in the house. And the teacher Bu' Sa'i'd ....

  5. he has three codices.
